newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP DRAINS PLN 1.969 BLN FROM POLISH MONEY MARKET.
newsitem.headline: NBP DRAINS PLN 1.969 BLN FROM POLISH MONEY MARKET.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland drained 1.969 billion zlotys from the market through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 2.423 billion with the central bank, the NBP said.
The bank accepted 664.15 million zlotys worth of bids for one day at an unchanged maximum rate of 21.50 percent after banks bid to place 669.15 million.
The bank allocated 1108.82 million zlotys worth of funds for four days at a maximum rate of 21.59 percent after banks bid to place 1115.83 million.
The bank accepted 195.92 million zlotys worth of bids for 14 days at a maximum rate of 21.70 percent, 2.54 point up from the last auction on November 28, after banks bid to place 638 million.
